criteria.listed_chunks_only: Final scripts may import only sibling files recorded in the bundle manifest whose hashes verify; every dynamic, remote, absolute, or runtime-native edge still fails, keeping multi-chunk output accountable without demanding one file.
criteria.single_file_only: Published scripts must contain no import edges of any kind, static or dynamic, because the browser build inlines the whole reachable closure, so any surviving edge proves an unaccounted or external dependency.

bundled_imports.instructions: Must shipped browser JavaScript be import-free, or may it reference manifest-listed bundle siblings?

criteria.follow_all_edges: Compute reachability over the full declared edge set, type-only imports included, and examine every reached body, on the ground that only executed inspection of each reachable file rules out hidden executable content.
criteria.skip_type_edges: Confirm type-only imports are declared and resolvable yet exclude them from reachability and body review, on the ground that transpilers delete them in a fixed pre-bundle pass, unlike tree-shaking which the audit must not trust.

reachability.instructions: Do import type and export type edges count toward which modules the audit must inspect?

criteria.baseline_plus_news: Freeze the host operations and native imports reachable in present browser output as tolerated, and fail only on operations or edges outside that frozen set, preserving a green build today while blocking fresh leakage.
criteria.fail_every_leak: Fail on each reachable host operation, native import, and server-dedicated module, even when present-day browser output contains it, and hand cleanup of generation and adapters to the scheduled follow-up tasks.

tolerance.instructions: Should the auditor fail present-day reachable host usage or tolerate it as a baseline?

state.context: The language serves no outside users, so no legacy spelling or artifact layout constrains the fix. UP10 replaces substring scanning of browser output with a structural audit over every generated, dependency, and runtime import plus host operation, exposing graph-level and final-bundle interfaces for the later packaging task. Defect B01 states the acceptance: literal text such as Bun., node: introduction, or require( must pass, genuine forbidden operations must fail, runtime bodies must face inspection, and tree-shaking must never be trusted to delete reachable forbidden code.
state.present_output: The browser state module currently pulls in logging whose fallback host writes through Bun.write, stdio helpers importing node:util, markdown rendering through Bun.markdown.html, and more Bun references across clock, asset, html, cookie, and CSRF helpers. Through http it also reaches assertion context, whose identity module imports node:crypto. These are live host touches reachable from the browser entry, not string literals.
state.type_only: The approved browser profile retains completion.ts, headed by a type-only re-export of AssertionContext from assert/context.ts that vanishes during transpilation. Separate value imports of the same assertion module, for instance denyLiveBoundary in http.ts, survive into execution.
state.work_split: Only the auditor belongs to UP10. Reachability pruning of emission is reserved for UP11, browser-side operation adapters for UP13, and the attested Bun.build packaging with runtime overlay and manifest for UP15. UP10 sets the acceptance line; those lanes change their own files to meet it.
